description:
Dorion is an alternative Discord client aimed towards lower-spec or storage-sensitive PCs that supports themes, plugins, and more!


# Changes

• Adds shared CEF to `.rpm`/Fedora release
  • This also scaffolds the ability to use shared CEF builds on other distros, like Debian and it's derivatives, once they have them
  • NixOS should also be able to use shared CEF binaries (I think)
• Update some libraries with security vulns (nothing major/to worry about)
• Remove `wgpu`, which should prevent some crashes 

[Original v7 changelog](https://github.com/SpikeHD/Dorion/releases/tag/v7.0.0)
